label: Brain metastases, native T1c (BEAMSTER)
description: Defaced skull-intact 3D post-contrast T1 MRI (157 × 218 × 169, 1.37 × 1.37 × 1.25 mm, tightly cropped to head FOV) with three left frontoparietal lung metastases from the open BEAMSTER cohort (CC BY 4.0).
expectedResult: Native-space brain and tumour-core masks (3 lesions, ~12.2 mL total), per-lesion morphometry with clickable centroids, MNI152 cortical lobe and Schaefer 7/17 overlap, and 64-tract BCB white-matter proximity.

label: Glioblastoma, skull-stripped T1c (UPENN-GBM)
description: Preoperative skull-stripped post-contrast T1 MRI (240 × 240 × 155, 1 mm) of an adult glioblastoma from the UPENN-GBM cohort (CC BY 4.0).
expectedResult: Tumour-core mask, native morphometry, MNI152 anatomical report and Kommers glioblastoma resectability index with skull-stripped mode enabled.
